description: ir_interp/backend.rs ~2398-2405 callable_value_arity computes abi.semantic_inputs.len() - capture_count, but semantic_inputs is sparse (the same file documents it at ~2549-2553, which is why both bind_executable_inputs implementations scatter by index). A closure whose target has a demand-ignored input renders the wrong #Function<.../arity>. Fix: input_len(types) - capture_count, i.e. World::activation_capture_count's own denominator. Signal: a fixture that dbg's a closure whose target ignores one input, expected arity on three doors (Elixir oracle for the arity digit).
title: [BUG] A rendered closure's arity subtracts the capture count from the sparse semantic_inputs length
